reading_notes: Header (Quote!A1) identifies vendor as SHAKTI PACKAGING INDUSTRIES, quotation ref SPI/QT/2026-0418, GSTIN 27AAGCS4412M1ZP. Major issue: the vendor's own item-code labels (column A) frequently do not match the dimensions given in the description for that same row against the RFX spec for that code. In 3 cases (rows labeled PKG-004, PKG-006, PKG-013) the described dimensions instead match a different, unlabeled RFX code exactly (PKG-003, PKG-005, PKG-015 respectively) with no competing row for that other code. In 3 further cases (rows labeled PKG-016/017, PKG-020/022, PKG-023/027) two separate rows each plausibly correspond to the same RFX code — one by code label, one by exact dimension match — at two different prices; these are reported under conflicts. Unit rates for rows labeled PKG-008, PKG-014, and PKG-023 are computed via formulas referencing a separate 'rate card' sheet (virgin kraft Rs46.5/kg + conversion Rs7.2/kg, multiplied by a per-item weight factor); I recomputed each formula and all cached values matched. The stated total (Quote!F25 = 12,566,359) was cross-checked by summing F7:F24 and matches, but this total covers only the 18 rows the vendor listed, not all 30 RFX line items. Currency is not explicitly labeled on the Quote sheet itself; INR is inferred from the 'Rs/kg' labels on the rate card sheet and the GSTIN reference, so a currency_inferred flag is applied to every line. The workbook also contains a hidden sheet named 'old' explicitly titled 'SUPERSEDED - Jan 2026 rates - do not send', containing a prior per-piece rate table for the same 18 codes; these values are not part of the active quote and are excluded from lines, but are noted here since the sheet was inadvertently left in the file. None of the six questionnaire items (ISO 9001, burst-strength certs, FSC chain-of-custody, lead time, 45-day payment acceptance, spare capacity headroom) are addressed anywhere in this file.
